scope: Native C++/Python pooled histograms over frozen C/T/Z ranges/explicit positions and whole/active/positioned area ROIs, without a concatenated stack.
semantics: Reuses resolver unions and existing histogram canonical-sample validation/bin-edge membership. Overlaps count once, unmatched planes have zero ROI members, nonmatching nonarea ROIs are ignored and matching nonarea ROIs refuse. All acquired samples are validated, even outside/without ROI members. Raw conventions match the single-plane service for pooled members; statistics use all finite members independently of explicit-range inclusion.
reads: Explicit ranges and UInt8 raw binning acquire each target plane once. Nonconstant observed UInt16/Float32 raw ranges acquire twice; constant/empty observed populations acquire once. The provider contract requires immutable contents across passes. Count/extrema checks are not complete content-change detection.
resources: Metadata/geometry admission enforces total target plane pixels, including ROI exterior/unmatched planes, plus conservative serial source/mask/raster/output/geometry/record/position storage. Source/provider cache/history, allocator bookkeeping, Python copies, opaque callback internals, CSV text and RSS remain external. Existing ROI mask routines are not a certified wall-time or fine-grained cancellation bound; full resource qualification remains open.
ownership: Targets/options/control and compact provenance are captured before execution callbacks. Results retain detached arrays/options/estimates/target metadata, with no source/provider handles. Native SDK weak-pointer testing verifies provider release. No source data/history mutation is performed; callback mutations of the live owner are independent user actions.
verification: 829 selected checks per OS including 53 new API cases; 36 existing histogram UI reports / 4980 physical-input frames requalified against current linked products. Four native executable suites per OS and fresh installed SDK consumers pass. Independent literal/formula membership/count/statistics tests, read budgets, strict bridges, no-read/callback refusals, completion cancellation, NaN payloads, argument capture, explicit ordering, invalid samples outside empty ROIs and detached ownership are covered. No new Java oracle or pooled UI acceptance is claimed.
